name: 29461 · Moncks Corner, SC
findings: ZIP 29461 (Moncks Corner) has 107 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29461 (Moncks Corner) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
